activation_contract.digest_scope: SHA256 of the original nonempty UTF-8 task bytes; never ACK or ACK+task
activation_contract.task_byte_rules: No BOM removal, newline normalization, trimming, appended bytes or substitution. Validate digest before UTF-8 decoding; transfer admitted task once without a second stdin read.
activation_contract.wire_order: empty owned stdin bootstrap -> one final policy event -> one matching ACK -> original task bytes -> EOF
activation_contract.thread_and_prewarm_barrier: Both ACK and complete correctly hashed task must qualify before thread creation or prewarm.
activation_contract.eof_rule: EOF after valid ACK and complete correctly hashed task activates normal execution. EOF is not a cancellation primitive.
activation_contract.cancellation_rule: Terminate/fence the owned process tree before closing pipes; preserve original deadline, settlement and uncertain-delivery reconciliation. Do not retransmit ACK, change original prompt hash or automatically retry.
activation_contract.deadline_fixture_scope: Disposable Node controller uses private process-group termination before pipe close. No native Windows watchdog qualification is inferred.
activation_contract.native_implementation_cancellation_limit: The normative kill-before-pipe-close contract is not proven for every actual Windows inflight-writer race; possible effects remain UNKNOWN and require reconciliation as recorded in native_source_risks.
